newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish PM to unveil revenue-raising package.
newsitem.headline: Turkish PM to unveil revenue-raising package.

text.p: Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan will unveil on Monday his third revenue-raising package which he says is to generate some $10 billion, officials said.
Erbakan will hold a joint news conference with Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller at 1300 GMT.

Officials said the government would pledge to privatise power plants, abolish a tax exemption on earnings from foreign bonds and bills, and give a retirement opportunity to Turkish workers abroad if they pay their premiums.
Two other packages, announced in August and September, had aimed to garner $20 billion.
The government set up a central cash management system, issued foreign currency denominated bonds, allowed a limited number of duty free car imports by Turkish expatriates under the packages.
It also seeks to speed up privatisation and sell state land and properties.
